# Spicy Blistered Soybean Sprout Salad

## Overview
Spicy Blistered Soybean Sprout Salad is a simple spicy cold vegetable salad. It offers a crispy and refreshing texture. This dish is simple to make.

**Estimated Cooking Difficulty:** ★★

## Ingredients
- Soybean sprouts
- Cucumber
- Garlic
- Green onion
- Peanut oil
- Ripe bell pepper
- Red pepper
- Chopped scallions
- Chili sauce
- Peanut sauce
- Vitamin C powder
- Vinegar
- Soy sauce
- Sugar
- Sesame oil
- Chili oil (optional)

## Preparation Steps
1. Cut the cucumber in half lengthwise, remove the seed part
2. Cut the cucumber into pieces about 3 cm long
3. Cut the bell peppers into thin strips
4. Mince the garlic
5. Cut the red and green peppers into strips
6. Wash and keep the soybean sprouts clean
7. Add the soybean sprouts to boiling water and blanch for 15 seconds
8. Remove the soybean sprouts and let them cool down
9. Add the schnelles salsa to soybean sprouts along with soy sauce, sauce, sugar, and peanut butter
10. Add half an inch of starch and stir well until smooth
11. Pour the cut vegetables and beans into soybean sprouts
12. Add two tablespoons of oil
13. Mix and served

# Spinach Tofu Salad

## Overview
This Salad is easy to make and very healthy. It is great for lunch or a quick snack. This salad requires some effort to prepare, but it is worth it if you want a healthy meal.

**Estimated Cooking Difficulty:** ★

## Ingredients
- Tofu
- Dashi
- Red bell pepper
- Cherry tomato
- Baby spinach
- Olive oil
- Balsamic vinegar
- Garlic
- Nutmeg
- Kosher salt
- Soy sauce
- Honey or syrup
- Black pepper
- Sesame oil
- Thread orange peel
- Chili oil

## Preparation Steps
1. Pick the spinach and wash it clean
2. Drain the tofu and cut it into 2 cm square pieces
3. Put the tofu in cold water and bring it to a boil
4. Let the tofu boil for 30 seconds
5. Take the tofu out
6. Cut the cherry tomatoes crosswise
7. Cut the red pepper thin slices
8. Put the tofu, red pepper and tomato on a plate
9. Mix honey, soy sauce, salt, and pepper
10. Drizzle olive oil
11. Drizzle vinegar over the red pepper and add balsamic reduction
12. Drizzle sesame oil over the spinach
13. Drag aluminum foil to cover the top of bowl
14. Seal strawberries with aluminum foil
15. Put the bowl in a freezer safe container
16. Seal the container to keep it quiet
17. Pop the strawberries into the freezer
18. Make a template for serving size
19. Put strawberries on top of standard cups with template
20. Add edible decorations
21. Press lightly on the strawberries
22. Release pressure
23. Place strawberries on serving tray
24. Add shredded coconut
25. Add scattered green apples
26. Add shredded tart apples
27. Garnish with sprigs
